reviewedMappings.2024-3-35:0: Original timeline states chronological Big Five; NPS list maps A–E. C largest and trilobites extinct at C, not D. A linked to glaciation/retreat; impact assigned to E.
reviewedMappings.2024-3-35:1: Only ㄱ true based on largest End-Permian; ㄴ and ㄷ mismatched events.
reviewedMappings.2024-3-35:2: End-Ordovician explanation concerns glaciation/retreat and sea-level change, whereas End-Cretaceous has Chicxulub impact; avoids absolute single-cause certainty.
reviewedMappings.2024-3-35:3: All trilobites died at End-Permian C, before End-Triassic D; ㄱ true, ㄴ false.
reviewedMappings.2024-3-35:4: Both ㄴ and ㄷ use wrong event assignments; correct assignments C trilobites, A glacial/climatic changes.
reviewedMappings.2024-3-35:5: Only ㄱ is supported; ㄴ and ㄷ false by event mapping.
